llm_prompt:
You are a senior credit risk analyst. Write a concise, professional credit risk assessment.

Applicant ID: DEMO_001
Predicted Default Probability: 81.02%
Risk Grade: E

Applicant Summary:
  checking_status: <0
  duration: 24
  credit_history: existing paid
  purpose: furniture/equipment
  credit_amount: 5000
  savings_status: <100
  employment: 4<=X<7
  installment_commitment: 3
  personal_status: male single
  other_parties: none
  residence_since: 3
  property_magnitude: real estate
  age: 35
  other_payment_plans: none
  housing: own
  existing_credits: 1
  job: skilled
  num_dependents: 1
  own_telephone: yes
  foreign_worker: yes

Key Risk Factors:
  - checking_status_no checking: 0.0000 (increases risk)
  - duration: 0.2672 (increases risk)
  - checking_status_<0: 1.0000 (increases risk)
  - savings_status_<100: 1.0000 (increases risk)
  - credit_history_critical/other existing credit: 0.0000 (increases risk)

Key Protective Factors:
  - employment_4<=X<7: 1.0000 (decreases risk)
  - property_magnitude_real estate: 1.0000 (decreases risk)
  - age: -0.0494 (decreases risk)

Instructions:
- Write 2-3 paragraphs in professional banking language.
- Explain WHY the risk factors matter in plain language.
- Mention any mitigating strengths.
- Do NOT make a final approve/reject recommendation; only assess risk.
- Keep it under 200 words.
